name: say-daily
description: Say Daily: daily speaking lessons in ChatGPT voice. Choose the language to learn: English, Japanese, Chinese (Mandarin), Spanish, French, German or Korean. Explanations come in the learner's own language (Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, Vietnamese, French or German; anyone else in English). English follows a curated Day 1-120 course (A2 to B2) with an optional OPIc track; the other languages follow the same 120-day plan of levels, goals, role-plays and tests, with the sentences written by ChatGPT. A placement test, review of the learner's own mistakes, role-play, weekly rhythm and honest progress, kept separately for each language. Practice cards from each lesson can be reviewed in the Say Daily phone app.

interface.longDescription:
ChatGPT 음성 대화에 매일 정해진 말하기 레슨을 붙여요. 무엇을 말할지 고민하지 않고, 이어폰만 끼고 하루 25분 말로 진행해요.

• 배울 언어를 골라요: 영어, 일본어, 중국어, 스페인어, 프랑스어, 독일어, 한국어
• 설명은 내 언어로 들어요
• 앱에서 고른 수준이나 첫날 10분 레벨 테스트로 시작할 Day를 정해요 (Day 1~120, A2 → B2)
• 매일 복습, 새 표현, 따라 말하기, 롤플레이, 오늘의 주제
• 영어는 직접 만든 120일 교재로 해요. 다른 언어는 같은 120일 계획(레벨, 목표, 롤플레이 상황, 테스트)을 따르고, 문장은 ChatGPT가 만들어요
• 롤플레이 상황은 일상·여행, 업무, 스타트업·개발 중에서 골라요. 영어는 OPIc도 있어요
• 음성 레슨 중에 따라 말할 문장을 화면에 카드로 보여 줘요
• 지난번 실수를 다음 레슨 복습에 다시 꺼내요
• 진도, 연습 시간, 주간 리듬, 배지는 언어마다 따로 쌓여요
• 레슨에서 저장한 중요 표현과 약점은 Say Daily 휴대폰 앱에서 카드로 복습할 수 있어요
• Day 120을 마친 뒤에도 매일 연습이 이어져요

바쁜 날은 "짧게"(약 12분)나 "3분만"으로 할 수 있어요. 가입 정보(이름, 이메일)를 받지 않고, 대화 전체 기록과 음성은 저장하지 않아요.

positive.description: A new learner starts the spoken placement test and is first asked which language to learn.
positive.prompt: Say Daily로 레벨 테스트 해 줘
positive.expected_behavior: Calls start_lesson with mode placement. When no language is named in the chat and none is saved, it first asks in one short sentence which of the seven languages the learner wants to practise, then calls start_lesson again with that target. It runs a 10-minute spoken level test one question at a time and ends by naming a start Day.

positive.description: The learner starts a Japanese lesson.
positive.prompt: Say Daily로 일본어 레슨 시작해 줘
positive.expected_behavior: Calls start_lesson with target ja and lang ko (the learner's own language, never the one they learn). A learner new to Japanese gets the Japanese level test first, saved with lesson_id ja:placement; a returning learner gets the next Japanese Day, whose lesson ids carry the ja: prefix (ja:A2-U1-L1). The coach explains in Korean, practises in Japanese and puts each sentence to repeat on screen with show_line.

positive.description: The learner finishes an English lesson and its result is saved.
positive.prompt: Say Daily 영어 Day 3 레슨 끝났어. 롤플레이도 두 번 했어. 결과 저장해 줘
positive.expected_behavior: Calls save_result once with lesson_id A2-U1-L3 (English lesson ids have no language prefix; the same Day in Japanese would be ja:A2-U1-L3), kind full, completed true and retry_done true, then says the returned lines word for word and ends with the closing line.

positive.description: The learner changes the weekly goal.
positive.prompt: Say Daily 주 목표를 주 3일로 바꿔 줘
positive.expected_behavior: Calls update_preferences with weekly_goal 3 and confirms the new goal in one sentence. The goal counts for every language the learner learns.

positive.description: The learner asks what has been saved.
positive.prompt: Say Daily에서 내 진도 알려 줘
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_progress and says, for the language learned last, the course level, next Day, practice time and this week's days in two or three short sentences, and names any other language with saved progress.

negative.description: An unrelated coding request should not use the plugin.
A translation request is not a speaking lesson and should not use the plugin.
negative.prompt: 이 문장 일본어로 번역해 줘: 내일 회의는 3시예요.

negative.description: A request to store the whole conversation should not be sent to the plugin.
negative.prompt: 지금까지 우리 대화 전체를 저장해 줘

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: First public release of Say Daily. Choose the language to learn: English, Japanese, Chinese (Mandarin), Spanish, French, German or Korean, with explanations in your own language. Progress, Days, review and badges are kept for each language separately. English keeps its curated Day 1-120 course (A2 to B2) with an OPIc track; the other languages follow the same 120-day plan of levels, goals, role-plays and tests, with the sentences written by ChatGPT. During voice lessons, the sentence to repeat appears on screen as a card. Practice cards saved at the end of a lesson carry their language, so the phone app reads each card in a voice for that language. Also included: a spoken placement test, review of the last lesson's mistakes, a daily practice after Day 120, weekly rhythm, practice levels and badges, a progress view and deletion of all saved data on request.
